English: Wicker Idol Stand
A humble arrangement of woven wooden idols, marking the first sacred space for West Germanic clans on the move. Simple, but inspiring unity and reverence among the tribe.
Offering Patch
A cleared earth patch for offerings—grains, trinkets, and livestock—enhancing the spiritual cohesion of the clan and reinforcing bonds among kin.
Sacrifice Table
A heavy, rune-carved table of stone or timber, used during festivals to offer up animals or symbolic gifts to the old gods, increasing tribal unity and spiritual authority.
Spirit Grove
A protected copse of ancient trees where rituals are held, considered sacred ground for communion with ancestors and spirits. Deepens faith and increases community strength.
Priests Pavilion
A sizable hide-and-wood structure for the clan priests, where they store sacred relics and interpret omens, giving direction and unity to the faithful.
Blessed Oak Hut
A sturdy hut built from sacred oak timbers, housing the clans most revered totems and icons. The hut becomes a focal point for seasonal ceremonies, strengthening faith and leadership.
Sacred Fire Ring
An encircled stone fire-pit, tended at all hours, whose flames are kept alive by chosen acolytes. The fire is believed to ward off evil and inspire unity in times of war or hardship.
Diviners Chamber
A wooden lodge for the clans diviners, filled with runic stones, ritual vessels, and scrolls. Here, the fates of the horde are read, and spiritual guidance is dispensed to all.
Shrine Hall
A grand timber hall, richly decorated with clan banners and ancestral effigies, where the entire tribe may gather for great rites, affirming unity and tradition in the face of adversity.
Sanctuary of the Spirits
A magnificent circular sanctuary of stone and sacred wood, attended by the greatest priests and diviners. It stands as the spiritual heart of the tribe, binding all clans to a common cause and faith.
